scope: Desktop working copy plus read-only inspection of the live 810-station project and its original RCP

desktop_change.api: Legacy cloud responses restore source_import from the original RCP only when its SHA-256 still matches import metadata; lookups are cached by path, size, mtime and ctime. The response is enriched only in memory; SQLite and source files are not changed.
desktop_change.frontend: Count warning can display recorded noise filter, intensity/range bounds, and raw density without interpreting unknown density units or claiming causality.
desktop_change.backend_tests: 2 passed; a hash mismatch suppresses manifest parsing and all provenance claims

autodesk_documentation.claim: ReCap project creation allows point inclusion to vary through noise, range/intensity limits and decimation; this makes those settings plausible factors but does not prove they caused this project's exact RCP/RCS count gap.

remaining: ReCap native GUI round-trip on the real multi-station project
independent interpretation of RCP NumPoints versus native RCS point count
deployment and browser verification of the Desktop API response enrichment
